messages:
ana: heads up — PR #473 (docs/sdk/java/upgrade-guide) failed docs CI: markdownlint + linkcheck + vale. preview: https://staging-docs/redwood/pr/473
vik: paste the errors?
ana: sure:
```
markdownlint: MD041/first-line-heading: First line in file should be a top level heading
linkcheck: Broken anchor: /api/sdk/java#client-configuration -> 404
vale: PROSE: PassiveVoice found in overview.md: 'is recommended to be used' -> prefer active voice
```
harry: the first-line heading error is from a short YAML frontmatter stray line. easy fix — move the H1 up.
vik: anchor change happened when we renamed client config section to 'configuration'. Should point to /api/sdk/java#configuration
ana: i'll push three tiny fixes: move heading, update anchor to relative link `/api/sdk/java#configuration`, and rewrite passive sentence to active voice. pinging @docs-owner for quick review after CI passes.
ci-bot: build started for PR #473 (docs-preview + markdownlint + linkcheck + vale)
harry: small note — when you rewrite the passive sentence, keep example code unchanged; vale sometimes flags examples if text and code disagree.
ana: pushed commit 1782503275 — heading moved, anchor fixed, sentence updated to active voice. Running local linters before pushing.
ci-bot: preview: markdownlint passed, linkcheck still failing due to a redirect from /api/sdk/java -> /api/sdk/java/ (302). log: https://ci.example.com/builds/10021/log
vik: linkcheck config treats redirects as failures for external domains but internal docs should allow trailing slash redirects. Can we canonicalize to include the trailing slash? `/api/sdk/java/#configuration`?
harry: prefer no fragment slash. use `/api/sdk/java/#configuration` will probably still work, but canonical path is `/api/sdk/java/` and anchor `#configuration`. So `/api/sdk/java/#configuration` is fine.
nana: pushed commit 1782503301 — updated link to include canonical trailing slash `/api/sdk/java/#configuration`
ci-bot: vale still warning: British spelling 'optimise' in examples/upgrade.md -> prefer 'optimize' per style guide
docs-owner: we should avoid changing technical terms unnecessarily. If 'optimise' appears in code sample or quoted external text, leave it. Otherwise change to 'optimize' to satisfy Vale.
vik: quick grep shows 'optimise' only in prose, not code. nana, can you update that one word?
ana: done in commit 1782503322 — replaced 'optimise' with 'optimize'.
ci-bot: all checks passed. Requesting review from @docs-owner
docs-owner: reviewing now. tiny nit on a code fence language tag (java -> java-docs) — fixed inline. Approving for merge.
eng-release: FYI — this is docs-only and within the doc cut. Fast-track approved, no eng-release signoff needed.
docs-owner: merging shortly.
ci-bot: PR #473 merged by docs-bot at 1782503328
ana: thanks team. follow-up: opened issue #235 to scan for British variants in sdk docs to reduce churn.
vik: nice — closing thread. :tada:
